title: P16-E capability-gap advisory — DRIVER_* fault classification persisted as a canonical owner-visible projection
description: P16-E: owner-visible capability-gap advisory (DRIVER_* fault classification → persisted projection). NEW objective-capability-gap.ts — canonical objective_capability_gap entity, ONE row per objective: every durable DriverDenial (closed DRIVER_* vocabulary only, else FAIL_CLOSED_CAPABILITY_GAP_LABEL) classifies into {gap_kind, permanence, owner_action: OWNER_* closed advisory — names a channel, never a command} + bounded evidence ring (8; at/fence/label, never raw error text) + occurrences + opened/resolved_at + digest pin (incl. entity_id+objective_id; updated_at excluded) + OPENED/RESOLVED event anchors (pins_digest/prior_digest/reopened/reclassified). recordGap idempotent per (objective,label,fence); label change on OPEN reclassifies; RESOLVED reopens on new denial; resolveGap state-idempotent. Write+read re-proof (mirrors read-grant validRows): digest-valid + identity-bound + lifecycle-event-consistent — a digest-RECOMPUTED state flip or event-less forge can never extend the projection; forged rows are overwritten by honest fresh mints (prior_digest forensic anchor), never laundered. gapFor = ZERO-write advisory — ANY unverifiable state → UNVERIFIED marker (FAIL_CLOSED_CAPABILITY_GAP_TAMPERED), never canonical, never throws into the status read (driver call sites also wrapped for hostile impls). objective-auto-driver.ts: deps.capabilityGaps? seam — recordDenial + noteGap (mid-pass denials + DRIVER_PASS_FAULT at untyped fault paths) + resolveGap on SETTLED + capability_gap in status()/statusReadOnly(); every call try{}-wrapped — a projection fault can NEVER mask a denial or block a settle; advisory never gates a drive, never writes on read. serve-mission-control.mjs wires the service; gap rides the existing owner-gated /auto-driver status + cockpit — no new route, no new authority. UI ObjectiveDetail: capability-gap row (OPEN → badge + owner_action; UNVERIFIED → warn marker; else hidden). Codex-only; advisory-only; zero enforcement change.
